messages.subject: Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed():
parts:
Hello, I have been using INLA to fit mixed effect step selection models from telemetry data using a conditional Poisson distribution. After several hours I get the following error message.

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.

I ran the models again with verbose = TRUE, but could not find anything that seemed to indicate an error in the output. 
Ben

Hello, 

I had resolved this issue by installing the test version of INLA and getting a pardiso license, but now after updating some packages that restarted R studio my pardiso license no longer works. I have gotten new licenses at least 10 times today trying to get it to work again but have not been able to. It tells my my user name is not correct. Any suggestions? I am at a loss for how to resolve this. Thank you. 

Ben
